About.missionBody: Our mission is to help Canadians build their dream business or grow their small business. We assist with opportunities such as applying for government entrepreneurship funding and professional marketing promotion.
About.objectiveBody: We aim to improve the lives and happiness of Canadian women immigrants through helping their small business or studio growing up; rich their leisure life with life coach consulting and personal growth courses including yoga and art etc., We aim to reach 500 immigrants per year!
About.visionBody: Our vision is to enrich women's leisure life and encourage them to live a healthy and beautiful life. We assist professional women in creating their careers and we encourage them to build a more prosperous life and diversified career.

Membership.intro: Join the Soul Good Happy Women Club and gain unlimited access to our exclusive workshops, mentorship programs, and a supportive community. Whether you're advancing your career, launching a business, or seeking personal balance, your journey to empowerment never stops here.
normalFeatures: Career Development Workshops 职业发展工作坊：职业规划、求职技巧、职场软技能等
Entrepreneurship Guidance and Training 创业指导与培训
Mind-Body and Holistic Wellness Program 身心和整体健康计划
Happy Families: Building Relationships 幸福家庭——发展关系
